title: Addressing the Reasoning Gap: Mechanistic Circuit-Based Knowledge Editing in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2604.05876v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in real-world dynamic environments raises the challenge of updating their pre-trained knowledge. While existing knowledge editing methods can reliably patch isolated facts, they frequently suffer from a \textit{reasoning gap}, where the model recalls the edited fact but fails to utilize it in multi-step reasoning chains. Our analysis shows that multi-hop reasoning relies on sparse circuitry beyond direct factual recall, with functionally differentiated components contributing to intermediate processing and final-answer prediction. translated_title: 弥合推理差距：基于机制回路的大型语言模型知识编辑
translated_abstract: 在现实世界的动态环境中部署大型语言模型（LLMs）带来了更新其预训练知识的挑战。虽然现有的知识编辑方法能够可靠地修补孤立的事实，但它们经常面临一个“推理差距”问题，即模型能回忆起编辑后的事实，但在多步推理链中却无法利用它。我们的分析表明，多跳推理依赖于超出直接事实回忆的稀疏回路，其中功能分化的组件对中间处理和最终答案预测有所贡献。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了MCircKE（基于机制回路的知识编辑），这是一个基于机制的框架，实现了“映射-适应”编辑流程。MCircKE首先识别负责特定推理任务的因果回路，捕捉事实的存储及其路由过程。
tldr: 本文提出MCircKE框架，通过识别和调整因果推理回路，弥合了知识编辑中的推理差距，使编辑后的事实能有效用于多步推理。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MCircKE, a framework that bridges the reasoning gap in knowledge editing by identifying and adapting causal reasoning circuits, enabling edited facts to be effectively used in multi-step inference.
